item.text: `limit_args` sets Codex’s total-context compaction limit to the smaller of the configured window and, after a `COMPACT` call, one token below the resumed session’s last request size; it emits no options if neither limit is available. `failed()` checks the portion of the error after a recognized status marker, when present, for statuses 502, 503, or 504 and for known connection or overload messages. It classifies those as `Unreachable` and all other errors as `Failed`, preserving the full error detail in either case.
